---
title: "Source of the slides"
execute:
  freeze: false   # always re-read slides.qmd
---

The [slides](slides.qmd) are one Quarto file, `slides.qmd`, shown here as written. R chunks run when the file is rendered, and inline code like `` `r knitr::inline_expr("round(avg, 1)")` `` puts results into the text. To render it yourself you would also need the data extracts and `_common.R` from this site.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
src <- readLines("slides.qmd", warn = FALSE)
# show shortcodes as written instead of running them
src <- gsub("{{<", "{{{<", src, fixed = TRUE)
src <- gsub(">}}", ">}}}", src, fixed = TRUE)
cat("`````markdown", src, "`````", sep = "\n")
```
